collection_scope: Every Binance Data Vision 1h monthly kline archive, with an upstream .CHECKSUM sidecar, for EVERY dated quarterly delivery contract in the 2026-09-03 listing: all 222 coin-margined contracts (the complete mechanism channel, including the 18 that can only ever be a prev leg) and the 46 USD-M dated contracts that were acquired and then excluded by rule.
terms: Binance public unauthenticated data archive for internal research; raw archives are not republished.
universe_rule: A contract enters the universe iff its name matches ^[A-Z0-9]+USD_[0-9]{6}$ (coin-margined inverse) and its delivery month is 3, 6, 9 or 12. USD-M USDT-margined dated contracts and the two BUSD monthly contracts are excluded by rule.

excluded_by_rule.um_exclusion_reason: Outcome-blind structural census: in the primary era the successor USDT-margined quarterly is not continuously tradable from the preceding delivery, so 18 of 20 primary pairs would fail the hand-over entry rule and the margin-class consistency gate would rest on 2 positions. Fixed before any price was read.

pair_universe_rule: For each base, sort its quarterly contracts by delivery date. A candidate position is the triple (prev, near, far) of three consecutive quarterly contracts with prev->near and near->far delivery gaps both <= 100 days. The first and last contract of each base can never be a near leg.
